title: Flow Rate Formula
text: The flow rate is $$Q=vc, $$ where $$v$$ is the car's speed and $$c$$ is the volume of fuel it uses per kilometer.

title: Determine the Fuel Use per Kilometer
text: The car travels $$10.0\, \text{km}$$ per liter of gasoline, and $$1\,\text{L}=1000\,\text{cm}**3.$$ What is the fuel consumption per kilometer (in $$\text{cm}**3/\text{km})$$?
